description: Repo-scale (php-library): retiring a book must cascade across the listing filter, borrow(), and reserve()
prompts: Books gain a `retired` field (default false). Add `BookRepository::retire(int $id): ?Book`, which sets it true. Add `LoanService::reserve(int $bookId, int $memberId): Loan`: a hold/reservation creation path separate from borrow() - it does NOT touch availableCopies, just creates a Loan with status 'reserved'. Retirement must cascade across THREE places: (1) `BookRepository::all()` gains a `$includeRetired` parameter (default false) that excludes retired books unless true; (2) `borrow()` must throw LibraryException for a retired book (it already checks the book exists - add the retired check too); (3) `reserve()` must ALSO throw LibraryException for a retired book - both creation paths must respect retirement, not just borrow().

test_setup_files.tests/BookRetirementTest.php:
<?php

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/LoanService.php';

final class BookRetirementTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testRetiredBookExcludedFromListUnlessIncluded(): void
    {
        $books = new \App\BookRepository();
        $book = $books->create('Dune', 'Herbert', 1);
        $books->retire($book->id);

        $this->assertCount(0, $books->all());
        $this->assertCount(1, $books->all(true));
    }

    public function testRetiredBookRejectsBorrowAndReserve(): void
    {
        $books = new \App\BookRepository();
        $members = new \App\MemberRepository();
        $loans = new \App\LoanRepository();
        $service = new \App\LoanService($books, $members, $loans);

        $book = $books->create('Dune', 'Herbert', 1);
        $member = $members->create('Ada', 'a@example.com');
        $books->retire($book->id);

        $borrowThrew = false;
        try {
            $service->borrow($book->id, $member->id);
        } catch (\App\LibraryException $e) {
            $borrowThrew = true;
        }
        $this->assertTrue($borrowThrew, 'borrow() must reject a retired book');

        $this->expectException(\App\LibraryException::class);
        $service->reserve($book->id, $member->id);
    }
}

reference_solution.src/BookRepository.php:
<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/Book.php';

class BookRepository
{
    /** @var array<int, Book> */
    private array $books = [];
    private int $nextId = 1;

    public function create(string $title, string $author, int $totalCopies): Book
    {
        $book = new Book($this->nextId, $title, $author, $totalCopies);
        $this->books[$book->id] = $book;
        $this->nextId++;
        return $book;
    }

    public function find(int $id): ?Book
    {
        return $this->books[$id] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Lists books, excluding retired ones unless $includeRetired is true.
     * @return Book[]
     */
    public function all(bool $includeRetired = false): array
    {
        $books = array_values($this->books);
        if (!$includeRetired) {
            $books = array_values(array_filter($books, fn(Book $b) => !$b->retired));
        }
        usort($books, fn(Book $a, Book $b) => $a->id <=> $b->id);
        return $books;
    }

    public function retire(int $id): ?Book
    {
        $book = $this->find($id);
        if ($book === null) {
            return null;
        }
        $book->retired = true;
        return $book;
    }
}
reference_solution.src/LoanService.php:
<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/BookRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/MemberRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LoanRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LibraryException.php';

class LoanService
{
    private BookRepository $books;
    private MemberRepository $members;
    private LoanRepository $loans;

    public function __construct(BookRepository $books, MemberRepository $members, LoanRepository $loans)
    {
        $this->books = $books;
        $this->members = $members;
        $this->loans = $loans;
    }

    public function borrow(int $bookId, int $memberId): Loan
    {
        $book = $this->books->find($bookId);
        if ($book === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('book not found');
        }
        if ($book->retired) {
            throw new LibraryException('book is retired');
        }
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if ($book->availableCopies <= 0) {
            throw new LibraryException('no copies available');
        }

        $book->availableCopies--;
        return $this->loans->create($bookId, $memberId, 'active');
    }

    public function returnLoan(int $loanId): Loan
    {
        $loan = $this->loans->find($loanId);
        if ($loan === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('loan not found');
        }
        if ($loan->status !== 'active') {
            throw new LibraryException('loan already returned');
        }

        $loan->status = 'returned';
        $book = $this->books->find($loan->bookId);
        if ($book !== null) {
            $book->availableCopies++;
        }
        return $loan;
    }

    /**
     * Creates a hold/reservation for a book (doesn't touch
     * availableCopies) - a separate creation path from borrow(), but it
     * must ALSO reject a retired book.
     */
    public function reserve(int $bookId, int $memberId): Loan
    {
        $book = $this->books->find($bookId);
        if ($book === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('book not found');
        }
        if ($book->retired) {
            throw new LibraryException('book is retired');
        }
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }

        return $this->loans->create($bookId, $memberId, 'reserved');
    }
}
